none: PAS NLM-2BA744: Roman Coin: radiate, possibly of Tetricus I
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate indeterminate, probably Tetricus II (271-274), possibly Cunetio no. 2667, Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---]TETRICVS AVG. Reverse description: Soldier with spear and shield standing left, Mars or Virtus. Reverse inscription: [VIRTVS] AVG. Diameter: 20.6mm, Weight: 2.22gms, die axis: 6
